metrics.input_contract: saved predictions only; target and geometry opened exclusively for evaluation
metrics.validity_scope: TipValid requires correct target within original tolerance, current start within 5mm, constant reach event state, and exact full tip-segment checks against supplied physical boxes with original clearance; excludes full-arm/IK/execution validity
metrics.unverified_geometry: The added physical boxes are checked. Table, walls, other environment bodies, arm volume and IK feasibility are not certified by this evaluator.
metrics.unknown_type_policy: Valid unclassified routes remain valid; they do not contribute invented types
metrics.reference_policy: Coverage only of known classified positive reference types; no total-solution-count claim
metrics.selection_policy: optional scores rank the same submitted K; missing scores yield null, all nonfinite scores fail selection

traditional_planner.language_scope: Exact TRAIN instruction/color prototypes only; unseen instructions abstain. No open-vocabulary claim.
traditional_planner.comparison_scope: Same exported TRAIN and DEV, RGB-D/current/language and K4; different inference runtime, no equal-time claim.
traditional_planner.limitation: Unknown space is conservatively blocked except explicitly recorded local contact allowances. Grid clearance is a discrete proxy, not a continuous physical 2cm certificate: cell-center depth tests and surface/segment quantization errors are not jointly bounded. Visible points do not reconstruct hidden solids or certify full arm/IK/execution. Independent unchanged true-box evaluation may reject proxy-clear paths.
traditional_planner.generation_budget_caveat: Planner emits4 complete paths; updated neural model emits4 drafts+4 finals. This is a lower-state-budget reference, not matched complete-generation count.
